# Deploy to VPS - Auto Deployment Workflow
# Runs automatically on push to main OR can be triggered manually

name: Deploy to VPS

on:
  # Auto deploy on push to main
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - '**.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/DEPLOY.md'
  
  # Manual trigger
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      deploy_message:
        description: 'Deployment message (optional)'
        required: false
        default: 'Manual deployment'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy to Production VPS
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Display commit info
        run: |
          echo "Deploying from: ${{ github.sha }}"
          echo "Author: ${{ github.actor }}"
          echo "Message: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}"

      - name: Setup SSH key
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          echo "${{ secrets.VPS_SSH_KEY }}" > ~/.ssh/id_rsa
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_rsa
          ssh-keyscan -H ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }} >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null

      - name: Deploy via SSH
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.VPS_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.VPS_SSH_KEY }}
          port: ${{ secrets.VPS_PORT || 22 }}
          script: |
            # Navigate to project directory
            cd /opt/areloria || exit 1
            
            # Git pull latest (if git repo exists)
            if [ -d ".git" ]; then
              echo "=== Pulling latest code ==="
              git fetch origin main
              git reset --hard origin/main
            else
              echo "No git repo, using existing code"
            fi
            
            # Install and build if needed
            echo "=== Installing dependencies ==="
            pnpm install --frozen-lockfile || pnpm install
            
            echo "=== Building ==="
            pnpm run build
            
            # Remove old type field if exists (fix for legacy projects)
            sed -i '/"type": "module"/d' package.json 2>/dev/null
            sed -i '/"type": "module"/d' server/package.json 2>/dev/null
            
            # Restart application
            echo "=== Restarting ==="
            pm2 delete all 2>/dev/null || true
            pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env
            
            # Wait and verify
            sleep 8
            
            # Health check
            HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
            if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
              echo "✓ Health check passed!"
            else
              echo "✗ Health check failed (HTTP: $HTTP_CODE)"
              # Show recent logs
              pm2 logs areloria --lines 5 --nostream | tail -10
            fi
            
            # Show status
            pm2 list
            
            echo "=== Deployment Complete ==="
            date

      - name: Upload deployment logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deployment-logs
          path: |
            ~/.pm2/logs/*.log
          retention-days: 7
